code:
use default

let prime_digits = [2, 3, 5, 7]

is_prime(value: int) -> bool =>
    value > 1 /\ ((2..value)
        |> take_while(divisor => divisor * divisor <= value)
        |> all(divisor => value % divisor != 0))

prime_digit_numbers() -> Pipe[int] is
    let level mut = prime_digits |> collect()

    do
        yield in level

        level =
            level
                |> flat_map(value =>
                    prime_digits |> map(digit => value * 10 + digit))
                |> collect()
    od
si

smarandache() -> Pipe[int] => prime_digit_numbers() |> filter(is_prime)

write_line("the first 25 Smarandache prime-digital primes:")

smarandache()
    |> take(25)
    |> chunk(5)
    |> each(row =>
        write_line(row |> map(value => "{value,7}") |> join("")))

write_line()
write_line("the hundredth: {smarandache() |> skip(99) |> first_or_throw()}")
